fixed_rules.quality: Require finite sidechain_sasa_complex_A2, sidechain_complete=True, chi_input_complete=True, nonstandard_residue=False. Identity sample_id/residue_index/amino_acid must match OOF. Quality exclusion is defined before reading feature values.
fixed_rules.matching: Same record/same amino-acid group >=4 after the quality filter; average rank/n percentiles recomputed in the qualified group. SASA percentile difference<=0.25 plus truth RMSF percentile difference<=0.25 or physical RMSF difference<=0.10 A. Enumerate every i<j pair. Target Hchi; all_close primary and target-percentile-separation>=0.50 secondary. Same aggregation and family-cluster bootstrap as frozen base protocol.
fixed_rules.caveat: Explanatory matching on MD RMSF. All-atom input SASA is not identical to the backbone-only model input, and ranks do not imply equality of absolute SASA; physical SASA balance is reported.
